POWER PLANT MOUNT
32-2
.
GENERAL DESCRIPTION
M1321000100094
The engine-transaxle mount is of an inertial axis 
supporting type whose excellent features have 
already been proven in many Mitsubishi vehicles. 
The inertial axis supporting type mount supports the 
front upper part of the engine at the front and the rear 
upper part of the transaxle at the rear. This 
arrangement effectively suppresses the engine 
vibration.
